release_notes: Massively improved post-round performance by moving practice saving, history refreshes and heavier analytics work out of the immediate UI path.
Practice rounds are now saved in the background, and recent-round history is updated incrementally instead of repainting the entire table after each round.

Improved UI responsiveness after finishing a round or practice series. Users can now start the next practice immediately without waiting for timing profile refreshes, skill rating calculations, problem character analysis, effective WPM suggestions or history summaries.
Added safer background processing for post-round analytics, including latest-result-wins logic so older background results cannot overwrite newer UI data.
Improved SQLite background access by using separate worker connections and WAL-friendly concurrency settings.
Optimized long-term skill panel updates by using stored per-round timing scores for the rolling timing component, avoiding expensive re-analysis of thousands of raw keying events after every round.
Kept round scoring behaviour unchanged: accuracy, cleanliness, WPM, timing score and saved round results continue to use the existing scoring logic.
Added more detailed structured performance logging for practice start, background saving, analytics scheduling, history updates and skill-rating refreshes.

Because the UI now remains smooth during large background calculations, the default recent-round analysis window has been restored to the last 1000 rounds for history, problem character, effective WPM and skill calculations.
